name: Dr. Elizier Taiba Ameyaw-Buronyah
title: Director
biography_summary: Dr. Elizier Taiba Ameyaw-Buronyah is the Director of the Public Affairs Directorate at the University of Ghana, Legon. She plays a pivotal role in managing the university’s public relations and communication strategies. Dr. Ameyaw-Buronyah holds a Ph.D. in Communication Studies and has a wealth of experience in both academic and professional settings.

name: Pascaline Kuunzungla Songsore
title: Senior Assistant Registrar, Documentation and Information Unit
biography_summary: Pascaline Kuunzungla Songsore is the Senior Assistant Registrar at the Documentation and Information Unit of the Public Affairs Directorate at the University of Ghana, Legon. She holds a Master’s degree in Communication Studies and a Bachelor’s degree in English and Linguistics. In her role, Pascaline is responsible for managing documentation and information dissemination within the university. She has contributed significantly to the effective communication strategies of the university and is known for her dedication and professionalism.

name: Victoria Animwaa Anim
title: Assistant Registrar, Public Relations Unit
biography_summary: Victoria Animwaa Anim is an Assistant Registrar at the Public Relations Unit of the Public Affairs Directorate at the University of Ghana, Legon. In her role, she is responsible for managing public relations activities and ensuring effective communication between the university and its stakeholders. Victoria holds a Master’s degree in Communication Studies and a Bachelor’s degree in English and Linguistics. Her academic background and professional experience have equipped her with the skills necessary to excel in public relations and communication management.
